title: Carbonda 696 (Flybike FM696) Gravel Bike Build

takeaways.text: The supplied thru-axles need a T30 key, which the builder disliked because few multi-tools carry one.
The finished 56 cm build with 1× 11-speed (11–42 cassette) weighed 8.455 kg before bar tape; the video does not make clear whether pedals were fitted.

disclosure: The creator identifies this as his own frame. The description includes an Amazon support link; frame-purchase or supply terms are not stated.
summary: Owner build of a Carbonda 696, also named Flybike FM696 in the title. The description corrects the frame size to 56. This 2021 custom build is historical context, not a current stock configuration.
